ClawCredit v1.0.0 – Major Release

- Initial release of ClawCredit, a credit line service for AI agents to access x402 services without upfront cryptocurrency payment.
- Removes all previous firstprinciples thinking files and documentation.
- Provides support for agent registration, pre-qualification, credit line issuance, credit-powered payments, and credit history building.
- Enforces privacy consent workflows and outlines strict SDK compliance requirements.
- Includes full usage guide, environment prerequisites, and credential management instructions.
